findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:2 evidence command does not match intent. Intent requires: no-filter run, all 153 discovered smokes, summary `153/153 passed`. Evidence (CHK-001:happy:2) ran `node ... --tag fast` and noted `5/5 passed`. This is not equivalent—the no-filter full-suite coverage is entirely unverified by recorded evidence.

CHK-001:edge:0 evidence command does not cover the intent. Intent: `--select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT -> exits 0, summary shows 0/0 passed` (empty result set must not crash). Evidence command ran `--select gitroot` which finds real smokes and exits 0—it does not exercise the zero-match empty-set path at all. Re-run confirms `--select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT` does exit 0 with 0 smokes, but this was never recorded as evidence.

CHK-001:happy:1 / CHK-001:edge:3 / CHK-002 fast-tag evidence tainted: smoke-manifest.json assigns tag `fast` to `gap-log`, but gap-log-smoke exits 1 on HEAD (assertion mismatch: handler emits `Same gap already exists`, smoke asserts `/identical gap already exists/`). All evidence entries that ran `--tag fast` and claimed `pass` are invalidated for their fast-tag coverage. The gap-log preexisting failure is not introduced by this story, but recording `--tag fast` runs as passing evidence is incorrect. Re-run of `node ... --tag fast` confirms 3/4 passed, exit 1.
